Name: Dialogue Display Tweaks - Configurable Dialogue Box UI
Author: ItsBenter
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LQeyWhM.png[/img]
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11662]Advanced Dialogue Display[/url], this mod adds configurable informational features for the dialogue box while trying to maintain the usual looks.

[b][color=#e69138]Info Box[/color][/b]
Adds a row on top of the dialogue box to display friendship indicator, hearts, and gift indicator. Can be configured to disappear when in events (requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿) and when talking to non-social NPCs (requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url]).
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iouUZIi.png[/img]
[b][color=#e69138]
Hearts[/color][/b]
Show hearts with the current NPCs talked. Behave the same as in the social tab. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KcOPc4q.png[/img]
[b][color=#e69138]
Friendship Indicator[/color][/b]
Refers to the animated icon on right side of the character portrait. Can be disabled or moved to the Info Box.

[color=#e69138][b]Gift Indicator[/b][/color]
Shows the amount of gifts given in the week. Behave the same as in the social tab. Can be placed in the Info Box or the Bottom Left of the dialogue box.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0Em063J.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EkNLPSm.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CqcVhaz.png[/img]

1. Can I use this mod in an ongoing save?
Yes, you can. The mod will take effect immediately after added.

2. Can I remove this mod in an ongoing save?
Yes, you can. There'll be no issue

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WtvzZ9s.png[/img]
